sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 89

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 89:1
items.html: The GAR of the Bina of the head are called the openings of the eyes, and the seven lower Sefirot of the Bina of the head are called the ear. (ibid.).
